title: Manchester United: Pochettino Gets Backing, But Patience Must Come First
body:
Manchester United's new head coach is reportedly set to get backing in the next transfer window, as the club try to fix a poor start to the season [S1]. Mauricio Pochettino was appointed after Michael Carrick was sacked from the role [S2].

Sky Sports presents the expected support as a direct response to that disappointing beginning [S1]. The same outlet also reported the appointment, so the new coach and the promised funding arrive as one package [S2].

The form explains the urgency. In the last five league matches, the side have won none, drawn three and lost two, collecting three points while scoring six and conceding eleven [ST1]. The run reads draw, draw, defeat, defeat, draw [ST1].

Those numbers are a warning, not a shopping list. A side shipping that many goals needs its shape fixed before it needs new faces, and a signing cannot repair a defence on its own.

The smart money is on patience. Talk is cheap until the paperwork is signed, so treat every rumour with care, and do not mistake a busy market for a sound plan.

The Touchline Take: judge the business when the window shuts, not before.
